images.seen: 107 states; Sasanian, Hephthalite, Alchon, Rouran, Northern Wei, Southern Qi all in place; world scale too coarse to judge Europe or India, so regional images followed

before the patch the Sasanian Empire held Khorasan, Margiana, Herat, Sistan and Baluchistan three years before Kavad I retook them (513) and Cliopatria's Hephthalites held them; after the patch (511) the Hephthalites hold them again and the map matches Cliopatria
before the patch the Sichuan basin east of Chengdu and Chongqing was grey (nobody's) from 553 after the Western Wei conquest of Xiao Ji's domain; after the patch it is Western Wei

matches Cliopatria except that Cliopatria's Turk Shahis (dossier starts 665) and 'Protectorate of the Western Regions' in the Tarim are not drawn; the 1,106 cells the Sasanian keyframe drops are the Hephthalite leftovers and agree with Cliopatria's grey; fine as drawn
Gothic War, Frankish constituents, Irish and British kingdoms, Mauro-Roman and Aures kingdoms all plausible; Italy Roman at end of 540 as in Cliopatria; no holes or stray speckle
Chen, Northern Zhou, Northern Qi, Later Western Liang match Cliopatria; the grey Hunan-Guizhou uplands are grey in Cliopatria too; Cuan clan drawn in Yunnan; fine
Himyar drawn as an Aksumite vassal, Kinda, Lakhmids and Ghassanids as vassals, Nobatia, Makuria, Alodia as in Cliopatria; nothing wrong

Lombards with Benevento and Spoleto, Exarchate of Ravenna, Avar-Byzantine contest in the Balkans, Frankish partition, Visigoths with Spania all plausible; Cliopatria has no Irish or Frankish subdivisions

Sui over all China with the Cuan contest, Eastern Turks contested by Tardu's Western Turks (8,945 cells, from the dossier's 599 ledger line), Chenla-Funan contest, Pyu, Dvaravati, Kamarupa, Maukhari, Later Gupta: nothing in the wrong place
Sasanian east border back at Cliopatria's 510 line; Hephthalites hold Khorasan until the 513 ledger gain

problems: Trial effect: conflicts 49,243 -> 45,227 cell-years and keyframe snaps 98 -> 95 against the published draft (other windows' newer patches included); end anchor p0600 changes 14 cells, none of them mine by design; no entry reaches into p0600 except through the unchanged spans of sui-dynasty_592 (to 601) and chenla_555 (to 616), which keep the Cliopatria shape.

Systemic dossier pattern: correction texts that say 'valid from N' or 'years changed only' carry no from/to, so the compiler uses Cliopatria's years. Seen here for sasanian-empire_510 and _567, sui-dynasty_592 and _587, kingdom-of-the-franks_510, chenla_555, chen-dynasty_561 (valid 560-572), goguryeo_555 (valid 553..611) and northern-wei_523; the first six are patched, the rest are quiet because the ledger covers the years.
northern-wei overrides 7-9 follow the p0400-p0499 patch (northern-wei_476); if that keyframe is withdrawn, withdraw these three with it.
goguryeo_523 override adds a small new conflict, goguryeo / rouran-khaganate 110 cell-years in 3 years (Goguryeo wins, smaller area); Cliopatria's Rouran shape reaches Harbin.

The 571-591 contest of eastern-roman-empire / sasanian-empire over the Armenian Highlands is labelled 'Hunnic invasion of 395' in the packet; the war name is wrong (a wars-list mapping in the dossiers; a patch cannot rename it).
Western Wei keyframes keep 672 cells (Tibetan plateau and the Liangshan uplands) out at 553 on purpose: the Liang never held them (Cuan and Dengzhi land).
hierarchy: no wrong row found in this window; the Himyar-under-Aksum tint at 530 and the Lakhmid and Ghassanid vassal tints were not checked against pages.
